sn27.10:1.2: yo bhikkhave rūpasmiṃ chandarāgo cittasseso upakkileso …pe… yo viññāṇasmiṃ chandarāgo cittasseso upakkileso.
sn27.10:1.3: yato kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno imesu chasu ṭhānesu cetaso upakkileso pahīno hoti nekkhammaninnaṃ cassa cittaṃ hoti
sn27.10:1.4: nekkhammaparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ kammaniyaṃ khāyati abhiññā sacchikaraṇīyesu dhammesūti.
sn27.10:2.5: kilesasaṃyuttaṃ. tassuddānaṃ cakkhu rūpañca viññāṇaṃ phasso ca vedanāya ca saññā ca cetanā taṇhā dhātu khandhena te dasāti.
